answer: An insider could forge multiple agent identities to drain shared resources. Mechanism prevents this: each new agent must stake cedar tokens as bond, bridging from wharf settlement layer to main chain. Forged Sybils cannot recover stake. Reputation score decays without active proof-of-work, creating single identity cost ceiling. Fork choice rule ignores minority chain, so double-spend fails. Honest agent identity stays privileged by consistent beacon attestation, not cloning hardware.
